name: Telugu
romanizationNotes: All Telugu content is presented in romanized form. Long vowels are doubled (aa, ii, uu, ee, oo). Aspirated consonants use an 'h' after the base consonant (kh, gh, ch, jh, th, dh, ph, bh). Retroflex consonants are simplified without capitalization. The letter 'ch' represents the palatal affricate as in 'church'. Double consonants (e.g., 'tt', 'dd', 'nn') indicate gemination. The sound 'zh' does not occur in Telugu. Stress typically falls on the first syllable.
